The atlas is credible enough to use for wedge-finding: reviewed gates do not pass, reviewed outcome coverage is 0, and reviewed step-phase coverage is 0.

bestWedge.title: Additive-assisted hepatocyte attachment and function benchmark on a fixed base cryomix
bestWedge.whyThisWedge: Several hepatocyte papers imply that post-thaw attachment and function gains come from adjuncts added around a standard DMSO-centered mix rather than from new base CPA chemistry.
bestWedge.currentPainPoint: Adjunct compounds recur in the literature, but they are not benchmarked head-to-head on a fixed base cryomix.
bestWedge.whyNow: A cleaner benchmark wedge maps to hepatocyte supply, cell-therapy, and drug-metabolism workflows where post-thaw attachment and function still vary lot to lot.
